title: GitHub Internal Repositories Breached via Malicious Nx Console VS Code Extension
summary: GitHub on Wednesday officially confirmed that the breach of its internal repositories was the result of a compromise of an employee device involving a poisoned version of the Nx Console Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extension.

title: Highly Critical Drupal Core Flaw Exposes PostgreSQL Sites to RCE Attacks
summary: Drupal has released security updates for a "highly critical" security vulnerability in Drupal Core that could be exploited by attackers to achieve remote code execution, privilege escalation, or information disclosure.
card_summary: Drupal has released security updates for a "highly critical" security vulnerability in Drupal Core that could be exploited by attackers to achieve remote code execution, privilege escalation, or information disclosure.

title: GitHub links repo breach to TanStack npm supply-chain attack
